name: starting architecture
last_analysis: Nine trials all scored exactly 0 on dev, and none had any successful builds in the last 10% of training either. The failures span five architectures (footprint pooling, layer-resolved heads, a plain residual CNN, a transformer, a dense action head) and recipes with 1–2 epochs, gamma 0.95–0.99 and entropy 0.003–0.01. So no tested change mattered. The cause is probably something these runs share, not capacity. The reward per placement is dense, so a myopic policy should already do fairly well: it only needs to place the brick that fills missing cells and add no extras. Two settings were never tested: a short horizon with sharp exploitation (gamma 0.9, lambda 0.8, very low entropy), and a separate critic, so that value learning stops interfering with the policy features. In this last round, all three candidates use the myopic, low-entropy recipe on three different architectures, so a single positive result would point to the recipe.
